title: Add scheduled meter sanity check job + alert hooks (drift/dupes/freshness)
author: Caleb Johnson
body:
## Summary
Adds a scheduled "meter sanity" job that aggregates key correctness/freshness signals for usage metering and emits alert hooks (Prometheus metrics + Alertmanager rules) with initial thresholds and per-env configuration.

This is the first step toward catching billing-impacting issues (late-arriving usage events, duplicates from retries/backfills, and drift between usage-event aggregates vs billing ledger) before Finance sees them at invoice preview.

## Motivation / context
We’ve had a few recent investigations where we only noticed metering anomalies after:
- customer disputes (invoice vs usage export)
- month-end close reconciliations
- experiment readouts looking "off" due to missing dimensions / duplicate events

This PR wires up automated daily checks and a small set of core KPIs so we can tune thresholds over time and start building an incident trail for "meter health".

Related:
- Linear: ENG-4421 (alert on drift vs billing ledger), PM-1842 (sanity-check KPIs), ENG-4415 (Console dashboard consuming the same aggregates)
- Support threads/tickets: SUP-28463 (double-charged retries), SUP-28451 (invoice vs usage export mismatch)

## What’s included
1) Scheduled job (k8s CronJob) that computes and stores daily aggregates
- Runs hourly for freshness checks + daily rollups at 02:30 UTC
- Writes results into `billing.meter_sanity_daily` (Snowflake) and also emits Prometheus gauges for near-real-time alerting
- Job is idempotent per (day, meter_version, env) and safe to re-run

2) Aggregation queries (initial set)
Per day, broken down by `account_id`, `product`, `meter`, `region`, `model`, `endpoint_family`:
- Freshness: max event lag (p95), % events arriving > 6h late
- Completeness: null-rate for required dimensions (region/model/account_id)
- Duplicates: duplicate usage_event_id rate; dedupe-key collision counts
- Drift: absolute and relative drift between usage-event aggregates vs billing ledger (tokens, requests, embeddings units)
- Outliers: z-score based spikes in per-account billed tokens vs trailing 7d baseline (guarded to reduce noise)

3) Alert hooks + configuration
- Adds Prometheus metrics namespace `meter_sanity_*`
- Adds Alertmanager rules (behind a feature flag by env):
  - `MeterSanityFreshnessSLOViolated` (page SRE + Telemetry)
  - `MeterSanityLedgerDriftHigh` (page Telemetry, notify Finance channel)
  - `MeterSanityDuplicateRateHigh` (ticket + Slack)
- Thresholds are configurable via `config/meter_sanity.yaml` and can be overridden per environment.

## Initial thresholds (subject to tuning)
These are intentionally conservative to avoid paging storms during rollout.
- Freshness: page if p95 event lag > 90 minutes for 2 consecutive runs
- Ledger drift: warn at >0.75% relative drift AND >$250 estimated impact (per account-day); page at >2.0% AND >$1,000 impact
- Duplicate rate: warn at >0.10% duplicate usage_event_id; page at >0.50%
- Missing dimensions: warn at >0.05% null region; page at >0.25% (per region/model breakdown)

Notes:
- The $$ impact estimate uses current pricebook table in Snowflake (approx; intended for prioritization, not accounting).
- Drift checks compare "eligible" rows only (same meter_version, excludes backfills tagged with `is_backfill=true` by default).

## Implementation details
- New service module: `billing/ops/meter_sanity_job`
- Query runner uses our existing Snowflake client with statement tagging (`app=meter-sanity-job`) for auditability.
- Stores both raw counts and normalized rates; emits metrics with labels capped to avoid cardinality blowups (account_id is hashed for Prometheus labels, full values only in Snowflake table).
- Adds a small library of query templates so ENG can extend without touching CronJob wiring.

## Files / areas changed (high level)
- `billing/ops/meter_sanity_job/*` (new)
- `billing/sql/meter_sanity/*.sql` (new)
- `deploy/k8s/cronjobs/meter-sanity.yaml` (new)
- `config/meter_sanity.yaml` (new)
- `observability/prometheus/meter_sanity.rules.yml` (new)
- `lib/snowflake/statement_tags.ts` (tagging)
- `docs/runbooks/meter_sanity.md` (initial runbook + triage steps)

## How to test
- Unit: `pnpm test billing/ops/meter_sanity_job`
- Local dry run against dev Snowflake: `./bin/meter-sanity --env=dev --day=2026-02-01 --dry-run`
- Staging:
  1. Deploy CronJob
  2. Verify `billing.meter_sanity_daily` populated for last 2 days
  3. Verify Prometheus targets scrape `meter_sanity_*`
  4. Temporarily set drift threshold to 0.0001 in staging to validate rule wiring (then revert)

## Rollout plan
- Merge behind `METER_SANITY_ALERTS_ENABLED=false` by default
- Enable in staging for 48h, tune thresholds
- Enable in prod with paging disabled for first week (notifications only)
- After 1 week, move drift/freshness to paging based on observed baseline

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Wire this dataset into Console dashboard tiles (ENG-4415)
- Add per-endpoint-family token counting invariants for OpenAI-compat endpoints
- Add explicit reconciliation hooks for month-end freeze window

---
## Review notes / discussion
**Logan Wright:** Please cap Prometheus label cardinality; do not put raw account_id in labels.
**Author:** Done. Account label is `account_hash` (sha256 truncated) for metrics; full `account_id` only in Snowflake table.

**Nadia Rahman:** Drift should be gated on comparable populations. Backfills and shadow billing comparisons can skew.
**Author:** Added `is_backfill` exclusion by default and a separate metric `meter_sanity_backfill_rows` so we can monitor when exclusions are hiding drift.

**Mei Lin:** Need a Finance-friendly view of the table + statement tags for audit.
**Author:** Added statement tags + documented the table schema in the runbook. Export permissions remain restricted.

**Aisha Bello:** Alert text should include pointers to queries/runbook and avoid paging on single-run spikes.
**Author:** Added 2-run confirmation on freshness/drift and included runbook + dashboard links in annotations.

## CI
- build: pass
- unit tests: pass
- lint: pass
- integration (staging dry-run): pass (reran after fixing missing env var in CronJob manifest)

## Release notes
Internal: Adds automated metering sanity checks (freshness, duplicates, drift) with initial alert hooks and configurable thresholds. No customer-facing changes.
